title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering under load
author: Evan Brooks
release_notes: Hotfix: Fixes SLO enforcer backoff thrashing and incorrect regional failover ordering under partial partitioning. Improves stability under bursty traffic and reduces false-positive failovers.
description: Context: Following a production incident (SUP-4123) where transient API gateway degradation caused the SLO enforcer to aggressively backoff and trigger cross-region failover ordering inconsistently, customers experienced increased latency and unnecessary regional failovers. Motivation: Prevent hysteresis/thrashing and ensure deterministic, quorum-backed regional failover decisions under partial outages. Summary: This hotfix stabilizes the enforcer by 1) introducing a deterministic backoff ordering that ties backoff priority to enqueue timestamp + configurable region bias, 2) adding a lightweight cross-region quorum check for failover approval to avoid spurious failovers during short partitions, 3) smoothing short spikes via feature-flagged backoff smoothing, 4) tightening the enforcer's metrics and alerting to detect oscillations earlier. Tests: unit + integration harness to simulate regional partition and burst loads; added deterministic replay inputs for regression prevention. Rollout: feature-flag gated by slo_enforcer.smoothing.enabled; gradual rollout to Dedicated customers first; monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_thrash metric and region_failover.count. Related work: ENG-2149, ENG-2170, SUP-4123. This PR is intended as an urgent hotfix with minimal invasive changes and has been squashed into a single commit for release.
commits: refactor(backoff): deterministic ordering using enqueue_ts + region bias
fix(failover): require cross-region quorum before promoting failover
feat(test): add integration scenarios for transient partition + burst load
chore(flags): add feature flag slo_enforcer.smoothing.enabled and default off
docs(obs): add metrics and alert playbook updates
review_comments: Ava Martinez: Can you justify the quorum thresholds? Would like to see a short paragraph in the code comment about tradeoffs.
Evan Brooks: Quorum threshold set to majority of healthy regions by default (configurable). Added comment and link to ENG-2149 for tradeoffs.
Liam Chen: Integration tests look good but flakey e2e at high concurrency - can we add a deterministic seed?
Evan Brooks: Added deterministic seeds to replay harness and extended timeout on the flaky scenario. CI rerun passed.
Sofia Patel: Alert tuning change may impact noise - recommend 24h monitor before broad rollout.
Evan Brooks: Acknowledged; rollout plan updated to 48h evaluation for Dedicated customers before enabling for hosted tier.
notes_for_oncall: If slo_enforcer.backoff_thrash spikes after rollout, rollback feature flag slo_enforcer.smoothing.enabled or reduce smoothing window. Watch region_failover.count and slo_enforcer.latency_p95. Use runbook docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer-oscillation.md.
post_merge_actions: Monitor: 48h evaluation window for Dedicated customers, then progressive enable for hosted. Backport: cherry-pick to release/2026-02-rc if regression appears. Telemetry: ensure slo_enforcer.backoff_thrash and region_failover.count are at steady-state before broad rollout.
